zh: 饮品选择列表不再显示无法在战斗中使用的茶类饮品。
价格弹窗的镜子成本改为总成本口径（现金成本 + 基准件出售价值），多轮结果与队列合计同步采用。
en: The drink list no longer shows teas that cannot be used in combat.
The mirror cost in the price dialog now uses a total-cost basis (cash + baseline piece sale value), applied consistently to multi-round results and queue totals.

zh: 导入配置时会自动清空已失效的茶类饮品选择，避免下拉框出现空白选项。
en: Importing configs now clears outdated tea selections, so the drink dropdown no longer shows blank entries.

zh: 修复旧配置残留茶类饮品时，战斗模拟可能一直卡住不出结果的问题。
修复镜子方案精炼装备低档输入件计价错误，现按基础物品计价。
修复镜子方案重复抵扣基准件出售值、净成本显示偏低的问题。
修复同物品 +1 升 +2 时镜子方案无法入队的问题。
价格确认失败不再关闭弹窗并清空已填写内容，修正后可直接重试。
修复基准件无市场价时悬停说明与实际提示相互矛盾的问题。
en: Fixed simulations hanging forever when older configs had leftover tea selections.
Fixed mirror plans pricing the lower input of refined gear as the refined item; it is now priced as the base item.
Fixed mirror plans deducting the baseline sale value twice, understating the net cost.
Fixed mirror plans for same-item +1→+2 upgrades failing to enqueue.
Price confirmation failures no longer close the dialog or wipe your entries; just fix and retry.
Fixed the baseline piece hover hint contradicting the visible text when it had no market price.

zh: 新增资产分（Gear Score）：导入玩家后，玩家名称旁会显示资产分，综合衡量其装备、房屋、技能书和公会神龛的市场价值。
鼠标悬停可查看各项明细，点击可复制。
en: Added Gear Score: after importing a player, a score appears next to their name, summarizing the market value of their gear, house, ability books, and guild shrines.
Hover to see itemized details, or click to copy.

zh: 资产分采用与 MWITools 相同的计算方式，优先使用官方估算和市场行情，数值贴近实际价值。
主站导入后立即显示资产分，分数随配置保存并随导出数据携带。
en: Gear Score uses the same calculation as MWITools, preferring official estimates and live market data, so values stay close to reality.
Scores appear right after import and are saved with configs and carried in exported data.

zh: 队列价格确认弹窗重构：每件装备可选左一价、右一价、手动输入或贤者之镜合成，买卖两侧报价同列对比。
新增贤者之镜合成方案定价：自动计算最低成本合成路线，缺价件可手动补价，基准装备可顶替 1 件输入。
设置页新增「队列定价」选项：可选择基准装备出售抵扣时使用右1或左1报价。
队列列表与 Excel 导出新增价格方式明细。
en: Reworked the queue price dialog: each equipment can use Left 1, Right 1, Manual, or Mirror pricing, with both sides shown for comparison.
Added Mirror pricing: auto-computes the cheapest combination path, with manual input for missing pieces and baseline substitution.
Added a "Queue Pricing" setting: choose Right 1 or Left 1 as the sale-side quote for replaced baseline equipment.
Queue list and Excel export now show the pricing method for each item.

zh: 价格显示统一使用紧凑格式（k/m/b）。
市场价格有更新时显示「新价格」徽标，可一键改用最新价。
确认弹窗中右一价没有实际买单（Bid）时，不再用 Ask 兜底展示：右一价列显示无价，右一价方案不可选。
确认弹窗中左一价没有任何参考价（精确 Ask、官方小时均价、历史 Ask 均缺失）时不可选，该行自动回退手动输入。
en: Prices now use a compact format (k/m/b).
A "New price" badge appears when the market price changes, with a one-click option to update.
When no real bid exists, the Right 1 quote no longer falls back to the Ask: the column shows no price and the Right 1 method is disabled.
When no reference price exists for the Left 1 quote (no exact Ask, official hourly average, or historical Ask), the Left 1 method is disabled and the row falls back to manual input.

zh: 修复弹窗中选定的定价方式被市场精确价静默覆盖，导致队列页与多轮模拟成本不一致的问题。
en: Fixed the chosen pricing method being silently overridden by the exact market price, causing queue and simulation costs to mismatch.

zh: 主站导入脚本新增「复制角色数据」按钮：在玩家资料弹窗中一键复制该角色资料（JSON），粘贴到模拟器导入导出弹窗即可导入。
队友分享资料导入现在直接采用主站下发的实际生效公会神龛战斗增益，未拥有的增益按 0 处理。
en: Added a "Copy Character Data" button to the main-site import script: copy a character's profile (JSON) from their dialog and paste it into the simulator's Import/Export dialog.
Teammate imports now use the effective guild shrine combat buffs issued by the main site, treating missing buffs as level 0.

zh: 优化主站弹窗检测性能，弹窗频繁开关时不再持续全量扫描。
非中英语言环境下，导入脚本界面统一回退为中文。
en: Optimized profile dialog detection on the main site, so frequent dialog toggling no longer triggers continuous full scans.
The import script UI now falls back to Chinese in non-Chinese/English locales.

zh: 修复「复制角色数据」按钮的挂载问题：短角色名会被弹窗内其它文字误匹配、弹窗打开与扫描冷却重叠时按钮不出现。
修复队友分享资料公会增益为空时静默沿用导入者手动配置的问题，现在统一按未拥有处理。
en: Fixed the copy button's mount issues: short character names matching unrelated dialog text, and the button not appearing when the dialog opened during the scan cooldown.
Fixed combat buffs silently reusing the importer's manual configuration when a teammate's guild buff data is empty; they are now treated as unowned.

zh: 新增未读更新预览弹窗，点击侧边栏集中预览所有未读版本。
更新日志页新增版本目录侧栏，支持跳转并高亮当前版本。
更新日志按「新功能 / 体验优化 / 缺陷修复」三分类展示。
en: Added an unread-updates preview dialog from the sidebar.
Added a Versions sidebar on the Patch Notes page with jump-to and current-version highlighting.
Patch notes are now grouped into New Features / Improvements / Bug Fixes.

zh: 细化未读标记：点击关闭或查看全部即已读，按 Esc 或点击遮罩保留未读。
en: Refined unread marking: Close or View all marks as read, while Esc or the backdrop keeps them unread.

zh: 修复语言切换后未读徽标残留、在更新日志页点击入口无响应的问题。
en: Fixed the unread badge lingering after a language switch and the sidebar entry being unresponsive on the Patch Notes page.

zh: 组队光环预览：战斗属性面板新增队友光环带来的属性变化展示，多人施放同一光环时按最强效果生效。
en: Party aura preview: the Battle Attributes panel now shows stat changes from teammate auras, applying the strongest one when multiple teammates cast the same aura.

zh: 优化模拟性能：增益到期改为定向清理，减少无效全量扫描。
en: Optimized simulation performance with targeted expiry cleanup for ability buffs.

zh: 修复自身光环被队友更强光环覆盖时，属性面板重复显示来源、数值归因错误的问题。
修复队友因饮品强化再次施放同一光环时，属性面板出现重复来源的问题。
en: Fixed duplicate source entries and incorrect attribution when the hero's own aura is overridden by a stronger teammate aura.
Fixed duplicate source rows when a teammate recasts the same aura after a drink boost.

zh: 新增公会神龛增益归因，每个神龛单独列出影响的属性及数值变化。
en: Added guild shrine attribution, listing each shrine's affected stats and their deltas separately.

zh: 战斗属性面板改版：属性按概览、输出、防御、效果、收益分组展示，并可展开查看基础值、各来源增量与最终值。
战斗属性现在显示模拟后的最终值（含卷轴、饮品、技能触发效果）。
en: Redesigned the Battle Attributes panel: stats are grouped into Overview, Offense, Defense, Effects, and Rewards, with expandable base value, per-source deltas, and final value.
Battle attributes now show the post-simulation final value (including scrolls, drinks, and triggered ability effects).

zh: 新增战斗卷轴：支持统一启停、逐项选择及有限或无限库存，普通战斗中每 30 分钟自动续期。
结果页显示卷轴用量；经验和掉落按怪物死亡时的有效卷轴结算，卷轴不计入成本，迷宫和公会试炼不生效。
en: Added combat scrolls with a global toggle, per-scroll selection, finite or unlimited stock, and automatic 30-minute renewals in standard combat.
Results show scroll usage; experience and drops use the scrolls active when each monster dies, scrolls are excluded from costs, and they do not apply in Labyrinth or Guild Trials.

zh: 修正模拟结束边界与长时间模拟中的结算偏差，并提升卷轴续期和掉落统计性能。
en: Fixed simulation-end boundaries and long-run settlement discrepancies, and improved scroll renewal and drop-stat performance.

zh: 同步游戏 8/14 市场与公会试炼更新，市场税率提高至 5%，所有市场卖出估值已扣除 5% 税。
牛铃袋 (10个) 市场卖出按官方特殊税率 18% 扣税，其余物品仍按 5%。
税后价格四舍五入取整为整数金币（官方取整规则暂未核实，集中一处可切换）。
同步神龛增益（稀有发现 1.5%/级、精华发现 3%/级）与公会试炼怪物数据。
en: Synced the Aug 14 game update: market tax raised to 5%, and all market-sale valuations now deduct the tax.
Bag of 10 Cowbells market sales now use the official special 18% tax rate; all other items remain at 5%.
Taxed prices are rounded to whole coins (official rounding rule unverified; centralized and switchable).
Synced shrine buffs (Rare Find 1.5% and Essence Find 3% per level) and guild trial monster data.

zh: 目标装备无市场价格时，支持手动输入买入价后加入队列。
买入价支持整数输入与 k/m/b 单位按钮。
en: Enter a manual buy price when target equipment has no market price.
Buy prices support integer input with k/m/b unit buttons.

zh: 手动价格仅用于对应队列项。
en: Manual prices apply only to the corresponding queue item.

zh: 更新日志从弹窗迁移为独立页面，进入页面后自动标记当前未读版本。
en: Patch notes now open on a dedicated page instead of a dialog, and current unread versions are marked as read when the page opens.

zh: 更新日志采用左侧版本、右侧内容的双栏排版，移动端自动切换为上下布局。
放大侧边栏导航文字和图标，未读更新圆点新增轻微呼吸提示并兼容减少动态效果设置。
en: Updated the patch notes layout with versions on the left and release details on the right, stacking vertically on mobile.
Increased sidebar navigation text and icon sizes, and added a subtle reduced-motion-aware breathing cue for unread updates.

zh: 官方精确 Ask 和小时均价均缺失时，可确认使用历史归档最新有效 Ask。
确认弹窗与队列警告显示价格来源和数据时间；新官方卖单仍优先。
队列仅在官方行情快照过期时刷新；新鲜快照缺少卖单时直接使用备用价格，避免重复请求。
en: Confirm the latest valid archived Ask when both the official exact Ask and hourly average are unavailable.
Confirmation and queue warnings show the source and data time; new official listings still take priority.
Refresh official market data only when its snapshot is stale; a fresh snapshot without a listing uses fallback pricing without a duplicate request.

zh: 缺少精确卖单时刷新官方行情，确认有效小时均价后可加入队列。
en: Refresh official market data when an exact sell listing is missing, then confirm a valid hourly average before adding the variant.

zh: 确认价格随队列项保存，运行时精确卖单优先。
队列页显示确认价格、成交量和数据时间。
en: Save confirmed prices with queue items; exact listings take priority at run time.
Queue shows the confirmed price, volume, and data time.

zh: 队列页新增移除单个队列项。
en: Added per-item removal to the Queue page.

zh: 队列装备成本改为完全采用市场定价：目标强化等级无精确卖单时禁止入队。
移除装备手填升级成本，基准装备无精确盘口时按 0 计算并提示。
en: Queue equipment costs now use market pricing only; variants without an exact sell listing are rejected.
Removed manual equipment cost input; baseline items without an exact quote are valued at 0.

zh: 食物、饮品和技能新增内联触发条件编辑。
en: Added inline trigger-condition editing for food, drinks, and abilities.

zh: 优化首页模拟工作台布局，完整结果改为独立标签页。
优化战斗命令栏与吸顶交互。
en: Improved the Home simulation workspace layout and moved complete results to a dedicated tab.
Improved the combat command bar and sticky interactions.

zh: 新增响应式侧栏与战斗命令栏，优化各页面布局。
新增亮暗主题并完善键盘操作与移动端适配。
en: Added a responsive sidebar and combat command bar, with improved page layouts.
Added light and dark themes with improved keyboard and mobile support.

zh: 全站界面升级为 shadcn-vue、Reka UI 与 Tailwind CSS 4。
en: Upgraded the full interface to shadcn-vue, Reka UI, and Tailwind CSS 4.

zh: 新增中英文图文使用教程，覆盖首次使用与数据导入、战斗模拟、队列比较、刷图推荐、强化、生活技能与设置。
en: Added illustrated Chinese and English user guides covering first use and data import, combat simulation, queue comparisons, Advisor, Enhancement, Skilling, and Settings.

zh: 生活技能计算新增“单项 / 全部”范围选择。
en: Added Single / All calculation scope to the Skilling planner.

zh: 生活技能升级路线改为按目标等级区间汇总展示。
优化生活技能工具栏的响应式布局。
en: Changed Skilling upgrade routes to summarize the target level range.
Improved the responsive layout of the Skilling toolbar.

zh: 生活技能模拟新增采摘。
新增采摘加工效果暂未计入的提示。
en: Added Foraging to the Skilling planner.
Added a notice that Foraging processing effects are not yet included.

zh: 强化模拟导入快照改为仅在当前页面会话保留。
en: Changed imported Enhancement snapshots to remain only for the current page session.

zh: 新增生活技能优化模式。
en: Added Skilling optimization modes.

zh: 升级路线改为整级模拟与逐级重算。
完善生活技能候选与路线展示。
生活技能导入快照改为仅在当前页面会话保留。
en: Changed upgrade routes to full-level simulation and per-level recalculation.
Improved Skilling candidate and route presentation.
Changed imported Skilling snapshots to remain only for the current page session.

zh: 新增生活技能升级推荐器。
新增生活技能路线总览与逐级明细。
主站一键导入脚本新增生活技能导入。
en: Added the Skilling Upgrade Planner.
Added Skilling route overviews and per-level details.
Added Skilling imports to the main-site import script.

zh: 战斗模拟器新增公会神龛增益：可为每名角色配置力量、节奏、精神、稀有和学者五项战斗 Buff，并计入普通区域、地下城与迷宫模拟。
en: Added guild shrine buffs to combat simulation. Force, Tempo, Spirit, Rarity, and Scholar combat buffs can be configured per player and now affect zones, dungeons, and labyrinths.

zh: 主站导入脚本现在会结合角色已购买等级和当前公会神龛等级，自动导入实际生效的神龛 Buff。
统一模拟器中的游戏实体名称为官方翻译，修复强化茶饮、装备槽、战斗属性及地下城/迷宫等位置仍使用本地自建词条的问题。
en: The main-site import script now combines purchased buff levels with the current guild shrine caps to import each effective shrine buff level.
Unified game entity names across the simulator with the official translations, replacing remaining local labels for enhancement teas, equipment slots, combat stats, dungeons, and labyrinths.

zh: 强化模拟和设置页的物品搜索现在可同时匹配官方中文名、英文名和 HRID。
翻译资源现在随版本离线加载，并新增发布前的官方词条同步、来源记录和完整性校验流程。
en: Item search on the Enhancement and Settings pages can now match official Chinese names, English names, and HRIDs at the same time.
Translation resources are now loaded offline with each release, backed by a pre-release synchronization, source-recording, and integrity-validation workflow.

zh: 游戏词条改为使用官网当前发布的中英文翻译快照，统一物品、技能、能力、动作、怪物、住宅、成就和战斗触发条件等名称。
en: Game terminology now uses snapshots of the official English and Chinese translations, unifying names for items, skills, abilities, actions, monsters, housing, achievements, and combat trigger metadata.

zh: 主站导入脚本新增强化模拟页入口，可导入当前角色的强化等级、强化装备、饮品、房间、社区 Buff 和成就加成。
en: The main-site import script now adds an Enhancement-page entry for importing the current character's enhancing level, gear, drinks, housing, community buffs, and achievement bonuses.

zh: 强化装备导入现在同时读取穿戴栏和背包；背包中没有穿戴装备的槽位会自动选择等级最高的装备。
en: Enhancement gear imports now include both equipped and inventory items; when a slot has no equipped support gear, the highest-level inventory item is selected automatically.

zh: 新增强化模拟器：可选择目标装备、起始与目标强化等级，并结合强化等级、辅助装备、饮品、住宅、社区增益和成就计算成功率、耗时与经验。
新增保护策略对比：自动比较不保护及不同保护起始等级，结合市场价格、保护物、材料、金币和工时成本推荐最低期望投入方案。
新增贤者之镜制作规划与强化装备分解价值参考，并支持不可交易装备的地下城宝箱获取估值。
新增成本风险分析：通过蒙特卡洛模拟或矩估计近似展示 P25–P99 成本分位、预算内成功率、随机种子和模拟进度。
强化页面支持中英文界面、配置与收藏持久化、价格覆盖及官方物品图标。
en: Added the Enhancement Simulator for selecting target equipment and enhancement levels, with success rate, time, and experience calculations covering skill level, support gear, drinks, housing, community buffs, and achievements.
Added protection strategy comparisons across no-protection and multiple protection thresholds, recommending the lowest expected investment using market, protection, material, coin, and labor costs.
Added Philosopher's Mirror build planning, enhanced-item decomposition value references, and dungeon chest acquisition estimates for non-tradable equipment.
Added cost risk analysis with Monte Carlo simulation or moment-based approximation, including P25–P99 cost percentiles, success-within-budget probability, seeded runs, and progress reporting.
The Enhancement page includes bilingual UI, persistent configuration and favorites, price overrides, and official item icons.

zh: 补齐相关制作项和材料名称的中文显示，查看配装、材料和制作信息时更容易对上装备。
en: Added Chinese names for the related crafting entries and materials, making loadouts, materials, and crafting info easier to match.

zh: 修复配装与技能页中部分 95 级鞋子显示英文的问题；开路靴、探路靴、寻路靴以及它们的精炼版现在都会正确显示中文。
en: Fixed some level 95 boots showing English names on the Loadout & Skills page. Pathbreaker, Pathfinder, and Pathseeker Boots, including refined versions, now show Chinese names correctly.

zh: 推荐刷图设置新增“快速扫描轮次”（可在 1–10 之间调节），按需在速度和精度之间权衡。
en: Added a Quick Rounds setting under Advisor (range 1–10), letting you trade off scan speed against precision.

zh: 推荐刷图扫描更稳：默认快速扫描轮数由 1 提升到 3，复核轮数由 10 提升到 20，同一目标多次扫描的排名波动明显减小；扫描耗时相应增加约 2.3 倍。
排名公式优化：收益高但每轮波动稍大的目标不再被过度压低，排名更贴近实际收益预期。
en: Advisor scans are more stable: default quick-scan rounds raised from 1 to 3 and refine rounds from 10 to 20, noticeably reducing ranking swings between consecutive scans of the same target. Scan time roughly 2.3x.
Tuned the ranking formula so high-yield targets with naturally noisier per-run results are no longer over-penalised and rank closer to their real expected payoff.

zh: 多件护甲装备新增“反伤伤害”属性，精炼加成同步包含该属性
en: Multiple armor items now include a defensive damage stat, with enhancement bonuses also covering this attribute

zh: 同步官方最新游戏数据：护符类装备（基础/进阶/专家/宗师）补充描述文案，明确说明其将战斗经验聚焦到对应技能
迷宫卷轴（采集/美食/加工/稀有发现/智慧）描述更新，明确标注仅在迷宫外生效；新增迷宫代币分解产物
成就“地下城精炼师”更名为“精炼师”，描述扩展为包含迷宫装备精炼
en: Synced with the latest official game data: charm equipment (Basic/Advanced/Expert/Grandmaster) now has descriptions clarifying that they focus combat experience to the corresponding skill
Labyrinth scrolls (Gathering/Gourmet/Processing/Rare Find/Wisdom) descriptions updated to note they are only effective outside the Labyrinth; they can now be decomposed into labyrinth tokens
Achievement "Dungeon Refiner" renamed to "Refiner" with expanded description including labyrinth equipment refining

zh: 设置页新增“成本分口径”，现在可以在严格成本和综合成本之间切换。
设置页的队列配置重组为“评分模型 / 执行与线程 / 采样与统计”三块，并新增“性能分内部优先级”，可以用收益和 XP 权重决定剩余权重如何自动分配到 DPS 与 Kills。
en: Added a Cost Score Metric option in Settings, so you can switch between Strict and Composite cost scoring.

Reorganized Queue Configuration in Settings into Scoring, Execution, and Sampling sections, and added Performance Priorities so Profit and XP weights can control how the remaining share is automatically split into DPS and Kills.

zh: 多轮结果页和导出表头会显示当前使用的成本分口径，排名规则更容易看懂。
多轮结果页现在也会展示当前性能子权重与中位数融合比例，综合成本和稳健聚合的计算方式更直观。
调整评分权重、性能分内部优先级、中位数融合比例或成本分口径后，已有多轮结果会立即按新规则重新排名，不用重新模拟。
en: Multi-round Results and export headers now show the current cost-score metric, making the ranking easier to understand.
Multi-round Results now also show the active performance subweights and median-blend breakdown, so the composite cost metric and robust aggregation are easier to interpret.
Changing score weights, performance priorities, median blend, or the cost-score metric now reranks existing multi-round results immediately, without rerunning simulations.

zh: 队列新增独立“基准轮次”设置，“设为基准”现在会按该轮数执行多轮基准聚合；设置页、多轮结果页和相关摘要也会同步显示基准轮次与完成样本数。
多轮结果新增“综合每0.01%所需金币”参考列，并同步优化严格成本列的命名、说明文案与导出展示，帮助更直观地区分严格口径和综合口径。
en: Queue runs now have an independent Baseline Rounds setting, and Set Baseline performs a multi-round aggregated baseline using that count. Settings, Multi-round Results, and related summaries now also show baseline rounds and completed samples.

Added a new Composite Gold per 0.01% reference column in Multi-round Results, and clarified the strict-cost column naming, explanatory copy, and export display so strict and composite cost views are easier to distinguish.

zh: 基准轮次默认值调整为 1；首次从顶部点击“设为基准”时会弹出提醒，明确显示当前基准轮数，并提供“我已知晓，并不再弹出”和“去设置”两个操作。
en: The default baseline round count is now 1. On the first top-bar Set Baseline click, a reminder dialog shows the current baseline round count and offers both "I understand, don't show again" and "Go to Settings" actions.

zh: 修复“每0.01%提升所需金币”在负提升场景下会静默剔除非正值、导致均值严重偏差的问题；现在只有当 DPS、利润、XP/h 和击杀/h 四项最终稳健增幅全部为正时才显示严格成本，否则统一记为 N/A。
en: Fixed the Gold per 0.01% metric silently dropping non-positive gains in negative-upgrade cases, which could heavily skew the average. The strict cost metric now appears only when the final robust DPS, profit, XP/h, and kills/h deltas are all positive; otherwise it is shown as N/A.

zh: 战斗区域遭遇节奏重新对齐官方通用规则：普通 Zone 的下一场遭遇固定按 3 秒刷新，不再把地图基础行动耗时误当成每场遭遇之间的冷却时间。
多怪区刷怪逻辑重新校准为按权重可重复抽取，并在首次超出怪物总强度上限时停止，修复在单人和多人模拟下战斗次数与总经验偏差过大的问题。
en: Zone encounter cadence has been realigned with the official generic rule set: regular zone encounters now always respawn after a fixed 3 seconds, instead of incorrectly treating each map's baseTimeCost as the cooldown between every encounter.

Multi-monster spawn generation has been recalibrated to use weighted repeatable rolls that stop on the first maxTotalStrength overflow, Fixed the issue where the number of battles and total experience deviated too much in single and multiplayer simulations.

zh: 战斗模拟现在会读取地图基础行动耗时，并将每场遭遇的最短节奏纳入下一波敌人刷新时间，避免刷图节奏被计算得过快。
这项节奏修正已同步应用到刷图推荐、首页 Zone 模拟与队列推荐模拟，相关收益、击杀频率与排行结果会更接近官方实际表现。
补充官方节奏对齐回归测试，覆盖遭遇节奏下限与 Jungle Planet 的 EPH 区间，便于后续继续校验模拟精度。
en: Combat simulation now reads each zone's baseTimeCost and applies the minimum encounter cadence to the next enemy respawn timing, preventing farming pace from being simulated too quickly.
This cadence fix now applies to Advisor recommendations, Home zone simulations, and queue recommendation runs, so profit, kill frequency, and rankings better match official behavior.
Added regression coverage for official cadence parity, including the encounter cadence floor and the Jungle Planet EPH band, to keep future simulation accuracy easier to verify.

zh: 首页“战斗属性”预览现在会按当前地图或迷宫上下文计算，并同步计入房屋常驻加成、MooPass、社区经验/掉落 Buff 与迷宫箱子效果，展示结果更接近真实开战状态。
食物、饮料、技能与任务徽章现在会在战斗属性面板中标出各自带来的属性变化；饮料与技能高亮会按触发条件、开场顺序和目标敌人重新计算，避免显示实际不会生效的增益链。
兼容保留旧版导入与主站导入中的任务徽章数据，用于首页预览任务伤害加成；该预览数据不会写入正式战斗模拟装备，避免展示专用效果误入实战模拟。
en: The Home "Battle Attributes" preview now evaluates stats in the active zone or labyrinth context, including housing permanent bonuses, MooPass, community XP/drop buffs, and labyrinth crate effects, so the panel better matches real combat start state.

Foods, drinks, abilities, and task badges now show per-source stat deltas in the Battle Attributes panel. Drink and ability highlights are recalculated from effective trigger state, opener order, and targeted enemies so inactive buff chains are no longer shown as active.
Legacy and main-site imports now preserve task badge data for Home preview-only task damage highlights, without carrying those preview-only items into actual combat simulation loadouts.

zh: 队列多轮模拟现已支持将食物、饮料与技能的触发器修改加入队列，方便批量比较不同触发方案的收益与表现
en: Queue multi-round simulations now support adding food, drink, and ability trigger changes into queue items, making it easier to batch-compare the returns and performance of different trigger setups.

zh: 队列项名称与详情中的触发器状态展示同步优化，默认、禁用、自定义之间的前后变化提示更准确
en: Queue item names and trigger-state details have been refined together, with more accurate before/after hints across default, disabled, and custom states.

zh: 迷宫箱子区域补齐咖啡箱、食物箱与茶叶箱三类下拉框，茶叶箱现在提供基础/进阶/专家三档可选数据
en: The labyrinth crate section now includes coffee, food, and tea crate dropdowns, with basic, advanced, and expert tea crate options.

zh: 首页迷宫区域下拉框改为走 i18n 显示，中文环境下迷宫名称不再直接显示原始英文名
“补给箱”文案调整为更明确的箱子区域展示，并补充茶叶箱相关中英文翻译词条
en: The Home labyrinth selector now uses i18n labels, so labyrinth names no longer show as raw English in Chinese.
The "Supply Crate" wording has been adjusted to clearer crate-area copy, and tea-crate related Chinese and English translations have been added.

zh: 主入口改为读取预生成的轻量游戏数据索引，首页、队列页、多轮结果页与设置页减少大体积数据直载，首次加载压力更低
首页战斗预览与设置页价格表等热点区域减少重复重算，频繁切换角色、调整配置或浏览价格时交互更流畅
补充优化路线与行为说明，便于后续跟踪性能调整与并行模拟配置
en: The main entry now loads a prebuilt lightweight game data index, reducing heavy direct data loads on Home, Queue, Multi-round Results, and Settings for a lighter first load.
Hot paths such as Home combat preview and Settings price tables now avoid repeated recomputation, making frequent character switches, config edits, and price browsing smoother.
Added optimization notes and behavior documentation to make future performance tuning and parallel simulation changes easier to track.

zh: Home 页批量 Zone / Labyrinth 模拟现在会正确沿用设置页保存的并行 worker 上限，刷新后再次运行也不会丢失该配置
en: Batch Zone / Labyrinth simulations on the Home page now correctly reuse the worker limit saved in Settings, and the setting no longer disappears after refresh.

zh: 队列收益模拟支持多人场景：设为基准时会冻结当前已选队伍，并在队列运行时带上队友一起参与模拟
队列页、多轮结果页、设置页和顶部操作区新增“冻结队伍”摘要与过期提示，方便确认当前模拟口径
en: Queue profit simulations now support party play: setting a baseline freezes the currently selected party and includes teammates during queue runs.
Queue, Multi-round Results, Settings, and the top action bar now show a "locked party" summary and stale warning so you can confirm the current simulation scope.

zh: 队列变体仍只针对当前玩家生成与排序，避免多人组队时把队友收益错误叠加到当前玩家结果中
当队伍成员或队友配置在基准之后发生变化时，队列会提示重新设置基准，防止旧基准与新队伍混用
en: Queue variants are still generated and ranked only for the active player, preventing teammate gains from being incorrectly folded into the active player's comparison.
When party members or teammate configs change after the baseline is set, the queue now prompts you to reset the baseline so old baselines are not mixed with a new party.

zh: 更新日志改为仅维护在 patchNote.json 中，首页弹窗与后续版本说明统一共用这一份数据源
移除设置页中的更新日志区域，入口调整为顶部悬浮栏按钮手动打开
首页更新日志不再自动弹出；存在未读版本时，顶部按钮会高亮闪烁提醒
首次切换到新未读机制时，历史更新日志默认标记为已读，避免旧版本持续闪烁
en: Patch notes are now maintained only in patchNote.json, and both the Home dialog and future version announcements share the same data source.
The patch notes section has been removed from Settings, and the entry is now opened manually from the top floating bar button.
Home patch notes no longer open automatically; when unread versions exist, the top button now highlights and flashes as a reminder.
When migrating to the new unread mechanism, historical patch notes are marked as read by default so old versions do not keep flashing.

zh: 新增版本更新公告功能：支持按公告 ID 记录已读，并将多条未读版本说明合并弹窗展示
en: Added version announcement support: announcements can track read state by announcement ID and merge multiple unread versions into a single dialog.

zh: 公告支持中英文内容、顶部聚焦与独立滚动查看，长内容阅读更稳定
同一版本公告仅提醒一次；后续新版本发布后会自动补发未读内容
en: Announcements now support Chinese and English content, top-focused layout, and independent scrolling for more stable reading of long content.
Each version announcement is only reminded once; newly released versions will automatically deliver any unread content later.

zh: 修复混合有/无日期公告时的排序问题，保证多版本公告展示顺序稳定
en: Fixed ordering when announcements with and without dates are mixed, keeping multi-version announcement order stable.

zh: 主站导入脚本完成合规性整改：导入流程调整为“当前角色直导 + 手动缓存队友资料补全”
脚本不会主动调用游戏 HTTP API，也不会自动发送 view_profile 或自动操作玩家资料弹窗
队伍导入仅使用你手动打开并缓存过的队友资料，缺失成员会跳过并提示
补充主站导入脚本的使用方式、限制说明与隐私说明
en: The main-site import script has completed compliance adjustments: the import flow is now "direct current character import + manual cached teammate profile completion".
The script no longer actively calls game HTTP APIs, automatically sends view_profile, or auto-operates player profile dialogs.
Party import now uses only teammate profiles that you have manually opened and cached; missing members are skipped with a prompt.
Added usage instructions, limitations, and privacy notes for the main-site import script.

多轮评分去极值、评分排名支持无效 0 分标记
评分排名新增“模拟次数”列（已完成/总轮次）与 Top1-Top5 分色高亮
多轮汇总新增评分指标解释，并补充中英文文案
新增迷宫模拟：支持单迷宫/全迷宫、房间等级与补给箱配置
多轮模拟改为“按轮次推进”，并在运行中实时更新原始数据与排名
评分权重调整为：性能45% + 稳定20% + 成本35%
评分并入稳健统计：Winsorize(5%)、中位数融合、置信度惩罚
优化评分排名队列项文案：换装显示“旧装备 -> 新装备(+等级)”并清理名称空格
导入/导出弹窗输入框占位符接入 i18n（中英文）

修复换装后成本不显示：首页与队列结果支持按槽位净成本（买入-卖出）计算与录入
新增装备变化模拟功能
新增队列多轮模拟，支持预设/自定义轮次（1-200）与并行、串行两种执行模式
新增“多轮结果”页面，提供汇总信息、评分排名和每轮原始数据（含DPS/利润/XP/h/Kills/h变化）
加入多轮综合评分模型：性能55% + 稳定20% + 成本25%，用于队列项排序
成本分析纳入升级成本、购买所需时间与“每0.01%提升所需金币（均值）”指标
补充中英文菜单与多轮模拟相关文案，并在基准或队列变更后清空旧多轮结果避免误读
